reference_provenance.purpose: Predeclared response anchors for checking reviewer discrimination and disagreements; not assistant performance or a calibrated human preference model.

reference_provenance.change_policy: Freeze this version and the complete dataset hash before independent review. Preserve observed reviews unchanged. Content corrections require a new reference version and a fresh hash-bound comparison; retain earlier disagreements.

extension.review_reuse_policy: Prior v1 reviews remain immutable. Reuse unchanged judgments only with explicit per-item blind-input and rubric hash verification plus prior-review provenance; reused judgments are not fresh v2 ratings.
